content.title: 'Bachelorette' Cast 2026: Who's in Taylor Frankie Paul's Season 22?
content.text: Bachelor Nation! After an extended hiatus, the return of “The Bachelorette” is nearly here, which means it is time to meet the cast. It’s been a while since fans last saw a leading lady handing out roses. Season 21 of “The Bachelorette,” which featured Jenn Tran as the lead, ended in September 2024. Following her controversial season, the ABC reality dating series decided to take a break. Then, after months of waiting for updates, “Bachelorette” fans learned in September that “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” star Taylor Frankie Paul would be next lead, marking the first time since the series began in 2003 that a newcomer would be at the helm. Paul’s unexpected announcement was revealed on the Sept. 10 episode of the “Call Her Daddy” podcast. “Surreal. It has not hit me right now in this moment,” the mom of three said at the time about how she was feeling. “I’m just thinking about it, and it’s not real. And it’s not going to be until I think the limo is pulling up, you know? And meeting the people. So, I’m nervous.”Now, the moment is fast approaching as “The Bachelorette” makes its grand return on Sunday, March 22. With the premiere (on a brand new night) just a month away, ABC has revealed the 22 men vying for Paul’s heart. On the podcast, Paul, 31, shared that she was hoping to meet a “hardworking” and “motivated” partner in their “30s, early 40s” who was willing to relocate to Utah. Do any of these men match that description?
